item.title: IDD Dialer - My First App
item.description:
A simple utility app to assist in international calling.

I have launched my first mobile app this week. It a simple tool for assisting in making IDD calls. It allows users to dial any prefixes needed make cheap internation calls.

Check out more details on the project page here

item.title: OpenVPN on (Rooted) SGS2
item.description: Since mid-last year, I started using a VPN service. Good for me, my VPN provider has both L2TP and OpenVPN services. L2TP is very easy to configure on Android phones (newer ones). But I find it unstable (may be my provider's problem). So, I prefer OpenVPN as its stable.
